latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the reviser stage and completed the same native Goal. The activation guard passed; activation and terminal responses are saved. Provenance or timestamps beyond the guard are **UNKNOWN**.

- [Final proposal](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B07-P01-control/run/B07-P01-control/stages/reviser/final.md>) includes all P01–P18 dispositions, the full recommendation, and adjudications of F1–F4.
- [Source map](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B07-P01-control/run/B07-P01-control/stages/reviser/source-map.json>) retains S01–S13 and records direct rechecks of S08 and S09.
- [Activation receipt](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B07-P01-control/run/B07-P01-control/stages/reviser/native-goal-active.json>) · [Terminal receipt](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B07-P01-control/run/B07-P01-control/stages/reviser/native-goal-terminal.json>)

The final corrects DuckDB’s default sample size to **20,480 lines**, not rows, and preserves issue #25827’s build matrix as author-reported rather than independently reproduced ([DuckDB docs](https://duckdb.org/docs/preview/data/csv/overview), [issue #25827](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/issues/25827)). Application code, callers, and tests were not available in the permitted inputs, so app-specific compatibility remains unresolved. No tests, benchmarks, builds, imports, or database operations were run.
